# IMatch.RoundWon event

Raised on the game's thread, on every game, when a round ends with a winner, as the winner's slow motion starts. It comes before the round winner banner and before the points are given, so a handler can change how many points the win gives ([`Points`](../RoundWonEventArgs/Points.md)).

public event EventHandler<RoundWonEventArgs>? RoundWon;
